incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 3345009876 — reserved pool 'resv-eu-west-1' at 98% GPU allocation. Autoscaler attempts failing (3x 429). Paging oncall: @Sara O'Neill, @Diego Ramos. Impact: reserved enterprise tenants may experience queueing/throttling. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/reserved-pool-pressure

Sara O'Neill (oncall): ack. Joining bridge now. Checking autoscaler and queue metrics.

Diego Ramos: on it. pulling prometheus briefly — queue growth spike starting ~2026-03-15T01:40Z, tenant=HelixQ accounts for ~72% of reserved token-sessions.

Mili Patel: Prom query I ran: `topk(5, sum_over_time(reserved_gpu_seconds{pool="resv-eu-west-1"}[15m])) by (tenant)` -> shows HelixQ, catalyst-runner, internal-eval. HelixQ sessions are long-running RL training-ish jobs (many tokens).

Jordan Li: suggestion: enable tenant fallback routing for non-critical routes (send to burst/shared pool with lower SLO) and/or apply session eviction for idle/long-running tasks.

Diego Ramos: looking at autoscaler logs: saw repeated 429s from autoscale API. Snippet:
```
2026-03-15T01:41:12Z ERROR autoscaler.api request failed status=429 body="rate limit exceeded"
2026-03-15T01:41:13Z WARN backoff next_retry=4s
```
Backoff code currently doubles and then gives up after 3 retries — that's our failure mode here.

Sara O'Neill (oncall): manual mitigation plan: 1) try short-term manual scale to add capacity 2) evict noisy sessions for HelixQ 3) enable fallback routing for background/non-urgent jobs 4) notify CS to inform customer. I'm starting manual scale now.

ops-bot: Action queued: manual scale request 3345009876-1 accepted. Adding 2 nodes to resv-eu-west-1. ETA ~4m.

Diego Ramos: identified noisy sessions list; will evict sessions older than 10m that are known background workers. Command: `redwood sessions evict --tenant HelixQ --age 10m --reason "noisy-reserved-eviction"`

Mili Patel: eviction run started. Patch script output: 
```
Evicting 14 sessions for tenant=HelixQ
Freed GPUs: 6. freed_memory_gb: 48
```
We reclaimed ~6 GPUs but pool still at ~86% after evictions.

Sara O'Neill (oncall): pinging infra to bump autoscaler API rate temporarily, otherwise manual scaling will be our fallback. @Jordan can you enable fallback routing for HelixQ non-critical endpoints?

Jordan Li: doing it now: `redwood route set --tenant HelixQ --fallback burst-pool --filter "job in (background, batch)" --max-qps 50` — applied. Also toggling model_profile for batch jobs to `small-quant` to reduce token GPU time.

Diego Ramos: infra confirmed temporary rate bump: autoscale_api_rate -> 120/min (was 60/min). Change applied. That should stop 429 storms.

ops-bot: Scale action complete: 2 nodes added to resv-eu-west-1. New allocation: ~82% used.

Sara O'Neill (oncall): good. Monitoring 30s windows — queue depth dropping now. I'll leave detailed metrics in the incident tracker.

Lina Park (CS): HelixQ has been contacted; they report elevated latency and a handful of 503s. We told them ETA ~10-15m for visible improvement and that we are adding capacity and evicting noisy background jobs. They asked for proactive notifications if this persists >30m.

Diego Ramos: additional note — autoscaler root cause: when autoscaler API returns 429 we backoff aggressively and abort further scale attempts for the window. Plan: emergency patch to alter backoff to retry through transient 429s, and alert on repeated 429 by autoscaler. I'll open a follow-up ticket.

Mili Patel: post-eviction metrics: `reserved_queue_length{pool="resv-eu-west-1"}` down from 420 -> 68 in 12m. Token per-second consumption down ~30%.

Sara O'Neill (oncall): marking incident as mitigation in progress. Severity: P2 (reserved enterprise tenants seeing increased latency but service still up). Bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridge/3345009876 — I'm primary for 1h then handing to Diego for overnight.

Jordan Li: note for postmortem: consider per-tenant throttles that can preemptively move background/batch traffic to burst pools when reserved usage >90%.

ops-bot: Note recorded in incident tracker #INC-3345009876: manual scale + eviction + routing fallback applied.

Sara O'Neill (oncall): creating short customer-facing timeline for CS. If this is contained <30m we won't escalate to full postmortem; if >30m we'll do a writeup. Leaving notes here and in the tracker.

Lina Park (CS): HelixQ acknowledged our update and asked to receive logs for the 503s if they continue. I've added them to the incident CC list.

Diego Ramos: follow-up tasks assigned: (1) emergency autoscaler retry patch (2) adjust autoscaler rate handling in config (3) add alert for autoscaler 429 bursts.

Sara O'Neill (oncall): I'm handing primary to Diego at 02:30 UTC (in ~55m). I'll stay on the bridge for the handover. If anything regresses ping @Diego directly.

incident-bot: INCIDENT 3345009876 — mitigation applied, monitoring. Current status: partial mitigation, continue watch.

Sara O'Neill (oncall): thanks all, going to handoff notes in tracker now.

Diego Ramos: thanks — will keep this open until autoscaler patch is live and we see stable allocation <85% for 30m.

(End of thread)
